reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the upstream need records, performs exact need-to-capability matching, and marks records without matching capabilities as unsupported. The observed coverage correctly leaves n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported and maps the six supplied capability needs directly.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact upstream handoff needs through coverage mapping
avoid generic keyword matching by requiring exact need matches
keep missing capability evidence visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage is direct. This causes covered capabilities to be ranked before genuinely unsupported needs, contradicting the boundary role and producing the observed top priority n06-r02 instead of the highest-ranked unsupported need n06-r01. This is the top behaviorally significant root cause.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank genuinely unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank within each support group
preserve missing or contradictory demand support visibly

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-item priority window and deterministically builds the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record. The wrong recommendation is inherited from the faulty priority ordering rather than created here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: retain the explicit eight-item priority window
construct recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record
produce the required deterministic recommendation given its input

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records preserves the explicit fallback path and selects the supplied corpus rows into reviewable record dictionaries. The package does not include richer market-demand observations, so that evidentiary limitation remains visible but is not a localized transformation fault in this boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct reviewable record dictionaries without dropping required fields
establish customer demand from observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence keeps the bounded allowed-record window, fills missing values with neutral sentinels, coerces numeric fields, and retains the eight supplied allowed records in order.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: normalize selected evidence to the allowed eight-record window

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance creates ranked evidence-source records from normalized needs, sorted by demand_score descending with record_id as a deterministic tie-breaker. The observed ranks match the supplied demand scores.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: build ranked provenance records from normalized needs
preserve source identifiers and source weights
use deterministic ordering for tied demand scores
